changelog:
Initial release of MindStudio Generate Text Block Prompting Skill.

- Guides users in writing, reviewing, and improving prompts for MindStudio Generate Text blocks (plain text or JSON).
- Provides comprehensive instructions for interviewing users to gather workflow and variable details before prompt writing.
- Details best practices for structuring prompts, including Markdown formatting and XML-style variable injection.
- Explains how to configure output schemas and sample outputs, especially for JSON, ensuring correct downstream workflow parsing.
- Includes example prompt templates and sample outputs to help users create production-ready prompts for both text and structured data scenarios.
